description: This file defines the DemoModeFilter class, which is a RestAssured filter used in testing to intercept HTTP requests in MOCK_MODE and return deterministic fake responses. It is used to simulate API interactions without making real HTTP calls during testing.

classes.name: DemoModeFilter
classes.description: A singleton final class implementing a RestAssured Filter to intercept and mock responses during API testing.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Main method implementing the filter logic to intercept HTTP requests and generate appropriate mock responses based on request details.
